Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293274. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
